Safety valves function to protect boiler from over pressure.

The first draft initiated by eng. Abdalla M. Abdalla, reviewed 
by directed by eng: Gamal Arafa, revised by EDEPC quality control eng. Samir Abd el-Gelil, accepted by general director eng. M. Abd el-Salam, approved by eng: 
Michael Goerge: head sector of Ayoun Moussa Steam Power Station 2x320 MW, 
and certified by eng. Aly Mostafa Al Lethy EDEPC inspection & quality control 
head sector.

A work permit must be issued and the qualified
maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.

Safety fence with caution marks must 
 be surrounding 
 the work area is required.

Wear the 
 safety 
 and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, ...etc).
The boiler must be drained, and the boiler vents must be opened

Hearing and eye protection should 
 be used when working on a valve which is under pressure.

Never strike a valve 
 which is under pressure. Premature actuation can result.

Never stand in front of the discharge outlet of a pressure relief valve, 
 which is under pressure.
Always approach and use any pressure relief valve with great care.
Complete maintenance tool set.
Cleaning fluid, manual puller,
Suitable lifting device Feeler gauge.

Hammer,
 and air wrench.

Remove the forked lever pin 23, 
 forked lever 22, cap 25, spindle nut cotter 28 and spindle nut12, 
 Figure 1

Remove the nozzle ring set screw
 and verify location

Remove the adjusting (guide) ring 
 set screw and verify location

Measure from bottom face of bottom spring washer tobonnet flange top face and 
 record dimension. Cut two pieces of bar stock 1/8" longer than recorded

Lubricate the spindle thread with "Never-Seez","Molykote-G", or equivalent, 
 and install the spindle lifter on the spindle

Lubricate the thrust bearing with suitable bearing grease and install 
 each part into the housing

The bottom thrust washer is guided into position on its outside diameter. 
 Install the cage on the bottom thrust washer. 
 Place the top thrust washer on top of the cage.

Install the housing on top of the valve bonnet, taking care to insure that the 
 key locates in the keyway slot in the 
 spindle lifter.

If the jacking 
 device has been properly installed, approximately 1/2" of the keyway should 
 be visible. The spindle lifter must be 
 screwed (clockwise) onto the valve spindle until the proper length of keyway 
 is visible.* 1/8" (3.18 mm): 1/2" H2.70 mm)

Lubricate the spindle lifter external threads and screw the operating nut onto 
 the spindle lifter until it contacts the thrust bearing.

Rotating the operating nut 
 clockwise raises the valve spindle thereby raising the lower spring washer and 
 compressing the spring.

After the spring load has been 
 taken up and the valve has been jacked approximately 1/8", 
 place spacer blocks under the lower spring washer.

The jacking device can now be removed by reversing The spindle nut may now be 
 installed to hold the spindle in position during disassembly. If desired, the 
 jacking device may be kept in place.

Using suitable lifting straps - cables - carefully lift the superstructure 
 straight up and out of the body.

Lay the superstructure down so that the spindle 
 is in the horizontal 
 position. Care must, be exercised to 
 prevent the parts from being damaged.

With the superstructure laying down, remove the spindle nut or jacking device 
 from on the spindle. You can now carefully slide the internals, see Figure 1, disc holder, disc insert, guide, guide ring and spindle as an assembly 
 from the spring and bonnet.

The safety valve should be reassembled in the reverse order of 
disassembly, this order of assembly will eliminate interference problems with 
each previously assembled group of parts

items:
Good seating on 
 the nozzle (2) and disc insert (35) are of the greatest importance when 
 reconditioning the safety valves

This is made of a 
 special grade of annealed cast iron perfectly flat on both sides which has 
 small squares

Use suitable 
 lapping compound

Never lap the disc 
 insert against the nozzle. Lap each part separately against the cast iron 
 lapping block of proper size

Lap the block 
 against the seat. Never rotate the block continuously, but use an oscillating 
 movement

When all the nicks 
 and marks have disappeared, remove all the compound from the block and seat.

Apply polish 
 compound to another block and lap the seat with this.

Introduction
This document outlines the major 
maintenance procedures P1, 
which must be performed every five years 
indicated by Y5 in the above title block.

The first draft initiated by eng. Abdalla M. Abdalla, reviewed 
by directed by eng: Gamal Arafa, revised by EDEPC quality control eng. Samir Abd el-Gelil, accepted by general director eng. M. Abd el-Salam, approved by eng: 
Michael Goerge: head sector of Ayoun Moussa Steam Power Station 2x320 MW, 
and certified by eng. Aly Mostafa Al Lethy EDEPC inspection & quality control
